entries.what: Linh rode her e-bike to Tamsen Valley for Anatomy at 9 a.m. and sat through the digestion lecture next to Rochelle. Afterward she looked up extra reading on the gut microbiome, though no test covers it.
entries.outcome: Saved a reading list and decided to read it over the weekend.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind from 3 to 9, charging the e-bike behind the counter, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets.
entries.outcome: Closed on time and took home a plate Hạnh left.

entries.what: Kenji gave her a ride to General Chemistry at 11. She spent the afternoon at the library with Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. anatomy group.
entries.outcome: Got through the bone models quiz without errors.

entries.what: Evening at home on Pell Road, she packed tomorrow's rice bowl and updated her color-coded notes and planner.
entries.outcome: Planner set for the Denny meeting tomorrow.

entries.what: Linh had Anatomy at 9 a.m., then met counselor Denny Wu at 2 p.m. They drafted a two-track plan: Bayshore nursing versus Bayshore public health, with the decision due by February.
entries.outcome: She left with a written two-track plan and a February deadline.

entries.what: Closing shift at the cafe from 3 to 9. Between rushes she told Jun about the plan but kept it vague.
entries.outcome: Jun said the numbers side suits her; she didn't mention it to Hạnh.

entries.what: General Chemistry at 11, with Kenji driving her. Afterward she reviewed her anatomy deck on the library steps.
Evening of studying at home to lo-fi, then dinner with Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh asked about pharmacy and Linh said school was fine.

entries.what: Halloween shift at Heron & Grind, working the whole day to closing. She drew skeleton latte art, and Calle Ortega filled with trick-or-treaters.
entries.outcome: The skeletons were a hit; Wes called her Doc.

entries.what: Closed the cafe, logged milk waste, and biked home past the street's string lights.
entries.outcome: Home by 9:45 and ate the plate Hạnh left.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind at 6:30 a.m. Sam was supposed to help but swapped out again.
entries.outcome: Worked the rush solo and noted the owed Saturdays.

entries.what: Got off at 1 and ate her packed rice bowl. Spent the afternoon on chemistry problem sets at the vault-wall outlets.
Evening at home, she planned next week in her washi-tape planner.
Sunday cafe shift from 6:30 to 1, then a walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk.
entries.outcome: Cleared her head by the egrets.

entries.what: Helped at the Lotus Nails front desk from 2 to 5 with Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh bragged about her latte art to a customer.

entries.what: Sunday night she set up her weekly planner and prepped rice bowls.
